title: Will the number of White House Press Briefings in Oct 2026 be at least 3?
rules: If the White House holds at least 3 press briefings in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room in October 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Any event held in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room where an administration official takes questions from or makes remarks to the press corps counts as a press briefing.

blind.reasoning: Only one October 2026 Brady Room briefing is confirmed: Katie Zacharia's first one on October 13. Recent coverage (Parade's 'White House exit' headline, a Washington Post piece advising 'the next one') suggests she left within days, so the job may be empty. Any official's remarks in the room count, and there are about 10 days left plus possible early-October briefings I couldn't check, but turnover and the pre-midterm campaign schedule make a sparse month quite possible.
blind.falsifier: Counts from transcripts or the White House video archive showing two or more more Brady Room events in October 2026 (from Leavitt early in the month, deputies, Vance or Trump) would make this too low. Confirmation that the Oct 13 briefing was the only one, with the job empty through Halloween, would make it too high.

final.reasoning: The 13% midpoint likely reflects traders' knowledge that only one October briefing has happened and the press secretary job is empty, so I cut my estimate from 50% to 18%. That sits only just above the 0.17 ask on evidence I couldn't fully verify, so the edge is too thin to bet.
